from collections import deque
n=24
edges=[(4,18),(5,20),(1,10),(0,19),(8,22),(8,16),(5,18),(1,23),(8,18),(4,17),(13,18),(7,12),(11,17),(4,15),(2,20),(5,14),(3,13),(7,18),(15,21),(7,9),(10,18),(12,19),(6,20),(6,11),(2,19),(0,16),(11,23),(0,21),(0,23)]
adj=[set() for _ in range(n)]
for u,v in edges:
    assert 0<=u<v<n
    assert v not in adj[u]
    adj[u].add(v); adj[v].add(u)
# girth computation
girth=10**9
for s in range(n):
    dist=[-1]*n; parent=[-1]*n
    dist[s]=0; q=deque([s])
    while q:
        u=q.popleft()
        for v in adj[u]:
            if dist[v]<0:
                dist[v]=dist[u]+1; parent[v]=u; q.append(v)
            elif parent[u]!=v and parent[v]!=u:
                girth=min(girth,dist[u]+dist[v]+1)
print('m',len(edges),'girth',girth)
# coloring by parts: 0 for 0-7, 1 for 8-15, 2 for 16-23. check
col=[0]*8+[1]*8+[2]*8
print(all(col[u]!=col[v] for u,v in edges),col)
print([len(a) for a in adj], sum(len(a) for a in adj)//2)
# find cycles <=6 brute? no
